title: その剣は、俺を知っている

scenes.name: 音の行き先
scenes.purpose: 音の出どころへ歩き、問いから剣の出現まで待つ

panels.art: Stone courtyard immediately after episode 1. Han Yun's hands now free of rope, arms lowering; blue-robed disciples keep their distance. An injured elder is attended by two disciples far behind, alive. Han Yun listens to a distant chime, then takes one cautious step toward an old wooden vault.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン

panels.art: Close-up of Han Yun's LEFT hand trembling briefly; he breathes out and closes his hand gently rather than making a fist. No visible sword yet.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン

panels.art: Sei Kou stands between anxious disciples and Han Yun, open palm holding everyone back. Calm face, no kneeling. Han Yun pauses.
panels.speaker: セイ・コウ

panels.art: Han Yun follows a thin gold light DOWN a long stone stair toward vault doors. Light is below, no sword visible. His face is wary, not triumphant.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン

scenes.name: 選ぶ剣
scenes.purpose: 第1話で伏せた天魔剣を初めて見せ、本人の戸惑いを読む

panels.art: ONE black straight sword floats horizontally with its gold guard toward Han Yun and blade pointing away from him, as if politely offering its hilt. Open vault behind, soft gold light. He leans back, astonished. No sword duplicated.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン

panels.art: Close hand detail: Han Yun slowly places his RIGHT fingers around the black wrapped hilt. Sword has not swung; only grip changes.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン

panels.art: Han Yun's right hand now firmly but gently holds the one sword, pointed safely DOWN. CYAN hologram with exactly two horizontal lines: 天魔剣　継承 / 隠しルート　開放. His eyes widen.
Sei Kou's large face, surprised and solemn, looking at the sword. Yun shown in profile at edge, still same robes.
panels.speaker: セイ・コウ

scenes.name: 地下の返事
scenes.purpose: 従う先を他人に決めさせず、地下の生きた声で次話へ

panels.art: Yun stands with sword safely lowered, speaking to the sect master in warm vault doorway light. Fear easing but no grandiose pose.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン
panels.text: 選ばれても、俺は俺です。

panels.art: Sei Kou extends ONE bronze key into Yun's free LEFT palm. Sword remains in Yun's RIGHT hand pointed down. Key transfer anatomically clear.
panels.speaker: セイ・コウ

panels.art: Deep stairs inside vault descending out of frame. Yun at top leaning to listen, one sword now safely SHEATHED at left hip in plain black scabbard. No person visible below.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン

panels.art: Close-up of a rough wooden cellar hatch and shaft of dim light, two gentle knocks suggested by motion lines but NO printed sound. Yun's startled eye partially at top margin. A balloon tail points DOWN beyond the hatch; do NOT show smith or prison yet.
panels.speaker: 地下の声

scenes.name: 名前を確かめる
scenes.purpose: 未知の相手と短く話し、安全を確かめてから扉へ進む

panels.art: At the CLOSED vault door, Yun turns toward Sei Kou, both hands EMPTY, wary. No sword visible.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン

panels.art: Sei Kou stops one pace away, keeps both open hands visible, speaks gently. Door remains CLOSED.
panels.speaker: セイ・コウ
panels.text: セイ・コウ。この門の主だ。

panels.art: Close Yun checks the rope marks on his now FREE wrist. He looks back at the exit, then at the master.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン
panels.text: もう、縛らないでください。

panels.art: Sei Kou steps aside to leave an unobstructed retreat. Yun takes a breath before facing the CLOSED door. No sword or vault interior yet.
panels.speaker: セイ・コウ
panels.text: 約束する。ここで待とう。
